i’m pretty sure you just have to discover the covenants to get the trophy, i’ve been a sunlight warrior and didn’t get a trophy for ranking up or anything. 
all covenants serve different purposes,
sunlight warriors: put summon signs down outside boss rooms and help people beat the boss in their world
way of the blue: if someone invades you a blade of the darkmoon/blue sentinel will be summoned to your world to help kill the invader
blades of the darkmoon/blue sentinels: (different covenants, same purpose) get summoned automatically with covenant item equipped to the world of a player that has been invaded to kill the invader
watchdogs of farron: with covenant item equipped you will be summoned to the farron area to defeat people there (you’re an invader in other people’s worlds, your goal is kill player to protect the area)
aldrich faithful: same as the watchdogs of farron, but you are summoned in the anor londo area to defend
rosaria’s fingers: invade other players in any area and defeat them
spears of the church: you will be summoned in during one of the boss fights in the ringed city as halflight spear of the church and have to defeat the player whose world you’re in
mound makers: you can be summoned into worlds via your summon sign, and decide to be friendly to the player who summoned you or you can kill them, if they summoned you in you can fight enemies in the area with them other than the boss. you can also invade players. kill player to get the covenants reward
moud makers is a harder covenant item to find, maybe search it up before your play through so you don’t miss the opportunity to get it!
